embeds.title: ARTICLE VI — MINOR-LEAGUE ELIGIBILITY
embeds.description:
The BLHA maintains **10 minor-league roster spots**.

A player must be **age 25 or younger**, using age as of **Sept. 15** immediately before the season. That age determination remains fixed for the fantasy season.

• Skaters remain minor-eligible through **100 career NHL regular-season GP**.
• Goalies remain minor-eligible through **50 career NHL regular-season GP**.

Once Fantrax identifies a minor player as ineligible, the franchise has **3 calendar days** to promote, trade, drop, or otherwise remove the player from the minor slot.

Promotion does not permanently burn minor eligibility. A still-eligible player may later return to minors where Fantrax permits.
